seed_actual: CLI has no seed option; actual SDK seed is recorded after load, not claimed fixed at 42. No sampler or question tuning follows outputs.
eval_batch_size: Actual native load configuration recorded; not controlled by CLI.
evaluator: Codex/AI-assisted source adjudication, not independent human adjudication. Automated checks do not certify factual accuracy.
development: Two frozen refined-prompt probes. No extra baseline prompt invented outside the freeze.
timeouts: 900 seconds per request, no automatic cap retry; errors checkpointed.
gold_exclusion: Gold files are read as binary for SHA256 verification only. Their text is never parsed or used by request builders.
